searchText: Would it make sense to add labels to PRs so people can sort through them better, for example: - `Status Change`: PR that only changes the status - `New EIP`: PR for adding a new file under `./eips` - `Update EIP`: PR for updating the contents of an EIP, not meant for status changes I use my email inbox feed to process EIPs. If other editors use the GitHub UI then labels may help them more than me (and thus they should answer). PR labels would be cool - maybe sometime the eip bot can do I'll note that update EIPs are often pretty uninteresting, especially for Drafts -- typos, grammar and such.

Would it make sense to add labels to PRs so people can sort through them better, for example:
- `Status Change`: PR that only changes the status
- `New EIP`: PR for adding a new file under `./eips`
- `Update EIP`: PR for updating the contents of an EIP, not meant for status changes
